patch_description: This redesign separates the solution into independent components: an interactive query broker, a landmark-ranking estimator, an estimated-weight partition optimizer, and an actual-balance repair stage. Instead of spending queries on complex incremental weight reconstruction, it uses sampled pivots to estimate global rank intervals under the known exponential-like distribution, performs deterministic local optimization on those estimates, then spends reserved queries repairing partitions using real group-sum comparisons. This improves maintainability and allows the final stage to directly exploit aggregate balance feedback.
